### A Psalm for Peaceful Sleep (Psalm 4:8)
Author: Lia Girard
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-april-2.html
Passage: Psalm 4:8
Points:
- Sleeplessness often stems from trying to control uncertain outcomes and circumstances.
- We easily turn to worldly securities rather than depending on God's provision.
- David offered praise and trusted God for safety during a severe crisis.
- God alone knows the future and provides the rest required for each day.
- Believers can find lasting peace by surrendering their internal storms to the Lord.

### Slumber and Song
Author: Sophia Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/slumber-and-song.html
Passage: Psalm 4:8
Points:
- Calming ambient routines help us relax, but true rest originates in God.
- David rested peacefully despite enduring dangerous opposition and unrest.
- Knowing the Lord sets apart His servants eliminates the need to live in fear.
- Believers can unburden themselves by laying heavy anxieties at the Father's feet.
- Genuine peace is found by resting in the presence of God who delights in us.
